name: Spontaneous Pneumothorax
description: A spontaneous collection of air in the pleural space causing partial or complete lung collapse. It may occur without known lung disease or secondary to an underlying pulmonary condition.
risk_factors: Underlying lung disease such as COPD
Male sex and tall body habitus are associated with primary spontaneous pneumothorax
physical_examination: Reduced breath sounds on the affected side
Hyperresonance to percussion may be present
Reduced oxygen saturation in significant disease
recommended_investigations: Thoracic ultrasound when appropriate and expertise is available
Chest CT in selected cases or when diagnosis remains uncertain
contraindications: Suspected tension pneumothorax is a medical emergency and urgent management should not be delayed for routine diagnostic processing.
